entities.summary: Barry Sonnenfeld is an American filmmaker and television director. He originally worked as a cinematographer for the Coen brothers before directing comedy films like The Addams Family (1991), the Men in Black trilogy (1997-2012), Wild Wild West (1999), and RV (2006).
